item.title: Biomechanics of the Sub-2 Marathon
item.description: Deconstructing the human physiological and engineering limits of endurance running: polyether block amide resilience, curved carbon-fiber plate leverage, lactate clearance kinetics, and wind-tunnel optimized aerodynamic pacing.

item.author: Ethan Wright

item.title: The Biomechanics of Sprinting

item.author: Liam O'Connor

item.author: Liam O’Connor

item.author: Liam O’Connor

item.author: Liam O'Connor

item.title: Lactate Shuttle Dynamics in Athletics

item.author: Liam O’Connor

item.author: Liam O’Connor
